text:
Lorenzo Bettoni is joined by Ben Dixon of SempreMilan for the latest episode of the Football Italia Show, with plenty to discuss, from Massimiliano Allegri’s struggles at Napoli to Como’s remarkable 9-1 Champions League win over Lens.
Football Italia Show: Allegri’s decline, De Bruyne-Lucca clash, Nico Paz shines and more!
Lorenzo and Ben take a closer look at Allegri’s decline, examining what has gone wrong and whether his problems began long before his arrival in Naples.
They also turn their attention to Como, where Anastasios Douvikas continues to fly under the radar despite his importance to the team.
Nico Paz, meanwhile, is increasingly attracting attention with his impressive performances and growing reputation. Could the Argentine return to Real Madrid sooner than expected? And does he have what it takes to compete with established stars such as Jude Bellingham?
All this and more in the latest episode of the Football Italia Show!
